semiconductors_us.name: Buy and Hold Semiconductors
semiconductors_us.source_note: SOXX, a US-listed semiconductor ETF, is a declared proxy for the MVIS US Listed Semiconductor 25 Total Return Index. The app has no licensed official MVIS total-return index history, so it does not claim this is the index or splice one into it.

semiconductors_israel.name: Buy and Hold Semiconductors Israel
semiconductors_israel.source_note: Kesem MVSMHTR mutual fund, security 5132972. Uses actual Maya redemption prices in ILS; the fund is currency hedged, priced once each day, and has no trading fee modeled.

japan_us.name: Buy and Hold Japan Nikkei 225
japan_us.source_note: Nikkei 225 price index (^N225). The app has no official total-return series configured, so this is explicitly price-only and is never presented as total return.

japan_israel.name: Buy and Hold Japan Israel
japan_israel.source_note: MTF Nikkei 225 currency-hedged ETF, security 1150531. Uses actual TASE prices in ILS. Each modeled buy or sale uses 0.05% commission with a 2 ILS minimum.

world_value_israel.name: Buy and Hold World Value Israel
world_value_israel.source_note: Tachlit World Value ETF, security 1189596. Uses actual TASE prices in ILS only; the fund is USD-hedged, so shekel/dollar moves are largely removed and hedge cost is embedded in its price. Management fee 0.40% plus trustee fee 0.01% are embedded in prices and are not deducted again. Each modeled buy or sale uses 0.05% commission with a 2 ILS minimum. No index back-calculation or pre-fund history is spliced in: history is whatever the public endpoint returns within the request window.

ex_us_israel.name: Buy and Hold Ex-US Israel
ex_us_israel.source_note: IBI tracking MSCI AC World ex USA mutual fund, security 5142476. Uses actual Maya redemption prices in ILS from 2026-05-06 only. Dollar/shekel moves are largely hedged; share-price risk and other underlying currency effects remain. Fund costs and hedge effects are embedded, with no automatic proxy extension.

russell_2000_israel.name: Buy and Hold Russell 2000 Israel
russell_2000_israel.source_note: Harel tracking Russell 2000 mutual fund, security 5139837. Uses actual Maya redemption prices in ILS from 2024-12-26 only. Dollar/shekel exposure is unhedged and already included in local fund prices. Fund costs are embedded, with no automatic proxy extension.
